newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bankinter to issue 25 bln pta 7-yr floating rate bond.
newsitem.headline: Bankinter to issue 25 bln pta 7-yr floating rate bond.

text.p: Spain's Bankinter said on Friday it was issuing a seven-year floating domestic bond for 25 billion pesetas ($168.9 million), which can be topped up to a maximum of 35 billion pesetas.
The issue price is par, with an annual coupon, payble twice a year, linked to the six-month Madrid Interbank Offered Rate (MIBOR) plus 0.18 percent. The yield is capped at eight percent.
The first coupon will be paid on January 18, 1998.

Subscription period will be between 0700 GMT and 1000 GMT on July 17. Issue and payment day is July 18, while maturity is July 18, 2004. But the issue is callable on July 18, 2002, and at the end of each subsequent half year until maturity.
In this case, prior notice of seven days will be given.
